llm_calls_nonnegative_check.name: llm_calls_nonnegative_check
llm_calls_nonnegative_check.value:
"llm_calls"."prompt_tokens" >= 0
        and "llm_calls"."cached_input_tokens" >= 0
        and "llm_calls"."cache_write_tokens" >= 0
        and "llm_calls"."completion_tokens" >= 0
        and "llm_calls"."reasoning_tokens" >= 0
        and "llm_calls"."reserved_cost_usd" >= 0
        and "llm_calls"."cost_usd" >= 0
        and "llm_calls"."latency_ms" >= 0

browser_handoffs_bounds_check.name: browser_handoffs_bounds_check
browser_handoffs_bounds_check.value:
("browser_handoffs"."detail" is null or char_length("browser_handoffs"."detail") <= 1000)
        and ("browser_handoffs"."page_url" is null or char_length("browser_handoffs"."page_url") <= 2048)

browser_tasks_submitted_check.name: browser_tasks_submitted_check
browser_tasks_submitted_check.value:
"browser_tasks"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'unverified', 'outcome_unknown')
        or "browser_tasks"."submitted_at" is not null

browser_tasks_bounds_check.name: browser_tasks_bounds_check
browser_tasks_bounds_check.value:
char_length("browser_tasks"."instruction") <= 4000
        and char_length("browser_tasks"."target_url") between 1 and 2048
        and ("browser_tasks"."status_reason" is null
          or char_length("browser_tasks"."status_reason") between 1 and 64)

email_classifications_decision_source_ch.name: email_classifications_decision_source_check
email_classifications_decision_source_ch.value:
(
        ("email_classifications"."decision_source" = 'classifier'
          and "email_classifications"."category" is not null
          and "email_classifications"."model" is not null
          and "email_classifications"."prompt_version" is not null
          and "email_classifications"."classifier_version" is not null
          and "email_classifications"."confidence" is not null
          and "email_classifications"."applied_rule_id" is null)
        or ("email_classifications"."decision_source" = 'rule'
          and "email_classifications"."category" is null
          and "email_classifications"."model" is null
          and "email_classifications"."prompt_version" is null
          and "email_classifications"."classifier_version" is null
          and "email_classifications"."confidence" is null
          and "email_classifications"."reasoning_effort" is null
          and "email_classifications"."applied_rule_id" is not null)
        or ("email_classifications"."decision_source" = 'correction'
          and "email_classifications"."category" is null
          and "email_classifications"."model" is null
          and "email_classifications"."prompt_version" is null
          and "email_classifications"."classifier_version" is null
          and "email_classifications"."confidence" is null
          and "email_classifications"."reasoning_effort" is null
          and "email_classifications"."applied_rule_id" is null)
      )

notification_outbox_kind_context_check.name: notification_outbox_kind_context_check
notification_outbox_kind_context_check.value:
(
        ("notification_outbox"."kind" = 'email_triage' and "notification_outbox"."classification_id" is not null and "notification_outbox"."approval_id" is null)
        or ("notification_outbox"."kind" = 'approval_request' and "notification_outbox"."approval_id" is not null and "notification_outbox"."classification_id" is null)
        or ("notification_outbox"."kind" = 'system' and "notification_outbox"."classification_id" is null and "notification_outbox"."approval_id" is null)
      )

user_settings_applicant_profile_check.name: user_settings_applicant_profile_check
user_settings_applicant_profile_check.value: "user_settings"."applicant_profile" is null or (char_length("user_settings"."applicant_profile") between 1 and 8000 and char_length(btrim("user_settings"."applicant_profile")) > 0)
